content.title: Who Is Keegan Bradley's Wife, Jill Bradley? All About Her Relationship with the Pro Golfer
content.text: Keegan Bradley on November 28, 2025 in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida; Keegan Bradley and his wife Jillian at the Presidents Cup Celebration on September 24, 2024 in Montreal, Quebec. Credit : Mike Ehrmann/Getty; Chris Condon/PGA TOUR via Getty NEED TO KNOW Keegan Bradley has been married to his wife, Jillian Bradley, since 2016They are parents to two sons, Logan and CooperKeegan and Jillian are featured in seasons of the Netflix documentary series, Full Swing Throughout his golf career, Keegan Bradley has been a force on the fairway and his wife, Jillian Bradley, has supported him along the way. The couple started dating in 2012, and three years later, Keegan proposed to Jillian. They married in 2016, and in the years since, have welcomed two kids, Logan and Cooper. In 2024, both Keegan and Jillian appeared in the Netflix documentary series Full Swing, which follows the lives of professional golfers on tour. “Jillian is the real champion of our family, she holds us all together,” Keegan said in season 2. The couple returned for the series' third season, and star in the fourth season, which premiered in April 2026. The athlete has previously paid tribute to his significant other on social media. For Mother’s Day in 2023 he posted a photo of Jillian with their sons on Instagram, captioned, “We are so lucky to have you in our lives. You make every day better. These boys adore you more than you’ll ever know, they are so lucky.” So, who is Keegan Bradley’s wife? Here’s everything to know about Jillian Bradley and her relationship with the professional golfer. She grew up in Vermont Jillian Stacey and son Logan James during the Par 3 Contest prior to the Masters on April 10, 2019 in Augusta, Georgia. Andrew Redington/Getty Like her husband, Jillian was born and raised in Vermont. After graduating from high school, she attended Eastern Connecticut State University. She and Keegan enjoy New England sports. Jillian has posted shots of herself supporting the New England Patriots and Boston Red Sox on social media. She married Keegan in December 2016 Keegan Bradley and Jillian Stacey during the Opening Ceremony for the 39th Ryder Cup on September 27, 2012 in Medinah, Illinois. Ross Kinnaird/Getty Keegan and Jillian first met in 2012, and the golfer proposed in Vermont in August 2015. Afterward, Jillian posted a photo of the two, in which she wore her engagement ring, on Instagram, describing herself as the “happiest girl in the world” and Keegan as her “best friend.” The pair married in December 2016, and Jillian later posted a few snaps from the day, including one of the couple embracing at their wedding reception. She wrote, “Still coming down from the happiest weekend of my life! Thank you to all involved and present, we love you.” They have two kids Keegan Bradley, Jillian Bradley, and kids stand with the trophy after the final round of the Travelers Championship on June 25, 2023 in Cromwell, Connecticut. Ben Jared/PGA TOUR/Getty Keegan and Jillian have two sons. Their older child, Logan James, was born on Nov. 13, 2017, with Jillian posting a photo of herself holding him on Instagram with the caption, “Craziest week of our lives! We couldn't be more in love with this little man, he has stolen our hearts.” Their younger son, Cooper, was born a few years later. The couple have largely kept their children out of the public eye, but they got some attention in June 2023 after Keegan won the Travelers Championship. At the tournament, Logan and Cooper were given their own trophies to help celebrate with their father. The following year, in December 2024, the PGA Tour shared a video on Instagram that showed Logan and Cooper running to hug their dad on the green. The caption on the post read, "The best job in the world — being a dad 🥹." She supports Keegan's career Keegan Bradley and Jillian Stacey during the Par 3 Contest prior to the start of the 2015 Masters Tournament on April 8, 2015 in Augusta, Georgia. Jamie Squire/Getty Jillian supports her husband’s career, and has served as his caddy before, too. Before the Par 3 Contest at the 2015 Masters, Keegan "proposed" to his then-girlfriend by asking her to caddy for him, and she shared a photo of the proposal on Instagram, saying that she was “so excited.” She was also there to celebrate and support Keegan when he won the Travelers Championship in June 2023, and has attended events, like the Ryder Cup Gala, with him previously. Shortly after, Keegan told GOLF that winning a championship with his wife and kids there was a better experience than winning as a single man, like he was in 2011 when he won his first major championship. "For them to be able to feel the excitement of this and be here and feel it, I can’t put a price on that, it’s just the greatest feeling," he said. When Keegan won the Travelers Championship again in June 2025, he emphasized how important Jillian is in making his golf career possible while talking to reporters. During a press conference after his win, he called her "the hero of our family." "Last night my 4-year-old was throwing up all night. I didn't know until I woke up today," he said. "So you know, she plays a major role in me doing what I do, and she allows me to be the best that I can be out here." Keegan added, "You don't always get that in sports or in business or in life, and she allows me to be the best that I can be, work on my game, practice as hard as I can, and I'm really grateful for that." She and Keegan have posted each other on social media Keegan Bradley and Jillian Bradley. Keegan Bradley Instagram Jillian hasn’t posted on her public Instagram since 2020, but has often posted Keegan on there in the past. In February 2019, she wished both her husband and Logan a happy Valentine’s Day with a photo of them together, while in June 2017 she wished him a happy birthday with a selfie of them together, saying, “Love you tons and so excited for our new adventures this year.” Keegan also often shares photos of his wife. For Jillian’s first Mother’s Day in 2018, he posted a photo of her with Logan and their dog, alongside the caption, “So proud to call Jillian my wife. She’s the best mum to both of these two stinkers. She amazes me every single day.” Related Stories She appeared on a Netflix show with her husband Keegan Bradley and Jillian Stacey during the Day Three Four-ball Matches at the Muirfield Village Golf Club on October 5, 2013 in Dublin, Ohio. Gregory Shamus/Getty Keegan was one of the golfers featured in the second season of the Netflix documentary series Full Swing, which follows a number of professional golfers. He appears in four episodes, while Jillian also appears in the sixth episode alongside him, in which he doesn’t make it to the Ryder Cup. In the show, they both discussed Keegan wanting to go to the Ryder Cup, as well as his PGA Tour victory at the Travelers Championship, which took place in Connecticut, not far from their home state of Vermont. Jillian said, “To win in front of the New England crowd, in front of both of our families, it was perfect. It’s one of those tournaments that we’d go to every year, and I know I just imagined picturing how cool it would be to win here.” Keegan and Jillian returned for Full Swing's third season, and appear in season 4, which premiered in April 2026 on Netflix. Notably, in the Full Swing season 4 premiere, the couple discuss the origin story of the golfer's lucky mustache.
